# DraStic DS shader bundle

These shader manifests and sources are preserved from the supplied
`drastic_ds_shaders` collection. The DraStic-format ports are by jdgleaver;
the individual `.dsd` headers retain the original shader authors and notices,
including Gigaherz, Greg Hogan (SoltanGris42), rsn8887, TheMaister, ShadX,
Hyllian, and Sp00kyFox.

The `.dsd` files are distributed under GNU GPL version 2 or, at your option,
any later version. See `COPYING` for GPL version 2. Some underlying shader
algorithms are additionally identified as public domain in their source
headers.

DrasticDS-nx preserves the original `.dfx` and `.dsd` files for OpenGL and
generates the adjacent Vulkan SPIR-V packs from the same sources at build
time. The generated packs are installed with the sources under
`/switch/drastic/shaders/Bundled/`.
